bio: La Vida is part of the Susana Balbo Winemaker's House & Spa Suites, a small luxury hotel in Chacras de Coria, a small town 13km from Mendoza, where everything revolves around wine. After the approach along a tree-lined track, the first thing to strike you here is the highly attentive service – you are met at the door and accompanied to the bar, and from there, with a welcome cocktail in hand, there’s an option of exploring this family hacienda before heading to your table to learn about the property’s history and admire its works of art.
